primary_anchor_zh: 画架位于画室左侧高窗旁
story_reason_zh: 画架被移去清理，随后放回左侧高窗旁

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型木画架在明亮画室的左侧高窗旁，保持静置并承托大画布。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 保持静置并承托大画布
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 画架位于画室左侧高窗旁占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 画家缓慢搬起画架并从画室门口离开画面；随后呈现高窗及其旁边的空地。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 画家缓慢搬起画架并从画室门口离开画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 画家缓慢将画架搬回画面并放在画室左侧高窗旁
shot_design.main_action_zh: 画家缓慢将画架搬回画面并放在画室左侧高窗旁
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 恢复画架位于画室左侧高窗旁，参照物保持清楚可见。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a large wooden easel holding a broad canvas beside the tall window on the left side of a bright studio. The easel remains still.

A fixed wide shot shows a large wooden easel holding a broad canvas beside the tall window on the left side of a bright studio. An artist slowly carries the easel through the studio doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the tall left-side window and the empty floor beside it. A thin curtain moves gently.

A fixed wide shot holds on the tall left-side window and the empty floor beside it. An artist slowly carries a large wooden easel with a broad canvas back into frame and places it beside the tall window on the left side of the studio.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 画家缓慢搬起画架并从画室门口离开画面
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 画家缓慢将画架搬回画面并放在画室左侧高窗旁
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
